description.content: Member Edge Constructor - points to peer reference
Capability - may read the content of the node
Propose Action Constructor - may propose changes to a link node
Accepts - the owner accepts this capability from the member (what may flow in from that peer)
Capability - reachable over HTTP (a server exposes it)
Capability - reachable over WebSockets (a server exposes it)
Capability - relays messages for peers that cannot reach each other (the fos server always has it)
